## Final prompt set

### connected-robotic-line.png

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: industrial automation website hero. Primary request: a modern flexible robotic automation cell connecting infeed conveyor, six-axis robot, machine station and guarded outfeed. Scene/backdrop: clean real-world advanced manufacturing floor, dark graphite safety fencing and orderly cable management. Subject: one unbranded six-axis industrial robot transferring a metal workpiece through a coherent production cell. Style/medium: highly photorealistic industrial editorial photography. Composition/framing: wide landscape elevated three-quarter view that clearly shows material flow from left to right. Lighting/mood: controlled factory lighting with restrained violet and teal status lights, credible and premium. Color palette: charcoal, graphite, neutral metal, deep violet and mint-teal accents. Materials/textures: powder-coated steel, polycarbonate guarding, aluminum extrusion, real factory floor. Constraints: physically plausible robot and guarding, no workers inside the cell, no text, no logos, no watermark. Avoid: cyberpunk neon, holograms, unsafe access, impossible robot joints, clutter.

### robotic-machine-tending.png

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: robotic machine-tending solution image. Primary request: unbranded six-axis industrial robot loading a machined metal component into a CNC machine through an open automatic door. Scene/backdrop: clean guarded machine-tending cell in a modern factory. Subject: robot gripper holding one metal component, CNC work area visible, safety fencing and external control cabinet. Style/medium: photorealistic B2B industrial photography. Composition/framing: landscape medium-wide view with robot, machine interface and safe perimeter visible. Lighting/mood: neutral practical factory light with subtle violet status illumination. Color palette: graphite, black, brushed metal, muted violet and safety amber. Constraints: technically plausible automation, safe arrangement, no people, no text, no logos, no watermark. Avoid: sparks, science fiction, dramatic fog, impossible gripper geometry.

### machine-vision-inspection.png

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: machine-vision inspection solution image. Primary request: high-speed machine-vision inspection station checking precision components on a conveyor. Scene/backdrop: enclosed industrial inspection cell with camera, controlled lighting tunnel, reject gate and clean conveyor. Subject: compact metal parts moving beneath two industrial cameras and diffuse inspection lights. Style/medium: highly photorealistic industrial process photography. Composition/framing: wide landscape low three-quarter angle following the conveyor direction. Lighting/mood: crisp controlled inspection lighting with restrained teal and violet indicator lights. Color palette: charcoal, stainless steel, cool white, teal and violet accents. Constraints: technically plausible cameras and guarding, no people, no text, no logos, no watermark. Avoid: holographic overlays, floating graphics, cyberpunk glow, unsafe exposed motion.

### automation-commissioning.png

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: automation integration and commissioning image. Primary request: automation engineer commissioning a robotic cell from outside the safety fence using a portable industrial control terminal. Scene/backdrop: modern factory integration area with robot cell, control cabinet and organized cable trays. Subject: one engineer in practical workwear standing safely outside guarding, focused on the terminal; identity not emphasized. Style/medium: photorealistic candid industrial editorial photography. Composition/framing: landscape medium-wide shot showing engineer, guarded robot and control architecture. Lighting/mood: realistic neutral factory lighting, calm technical collaboration. Color palette: graphite, industrial gray, deep violet and muted mint accents. Materials/textures: real workwear, steel fencing, cable trays, polycarbonate panels. Constraints: safe posture and location, no readable screen text, no logos, no watermark. Avoid: hard hats unless required, staged handshake, sparks, cyberpunk visuals.

### social-preview.png

Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: social preview card for a fictional industrial automation integrator. Primary request: premium landscape social card showing a connected robotic production cell with visible infeed, robot, inspection and outfeed flow. Scene/backdrop: dark graphite technical background with restrained violet and mint system paths. Subject: photorealistic automation cell on the right; bold editorial typography on the left. Style/medium: sophisticated B2B automation campaign design, precise and architectural. Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, text safely inside margins, system flow readable at small preview size. Lighting/mood: high contrast but credible industrial lighting. Color palette: graphite black, deep violet, muted mint and white. Text (verbatim): “KINETRA AUTOMATION” and “Connect the line. Clarify the outcome.” Constraints: render both text lines exactly once; no other text; no logos or trademarks; no watermark; physically plausible robot cell. Avoid: cyberpunk neon, holograms, futuristic fantasy, clutter.

## Demo boundary

These images visualize fictional systems only. They are not evidence of a real facility, installation, safety validation, customer engagement, production result, certification or commercially available machine.
